instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, the notebook goes on the pile of books, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_notebook")

# Find a valid edge pinch candidate
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("edge_free_below"):
        chosen = c
        break

if not chosen:
    chosen = candidates[0]

# Unpack grasp pose
gx, gy = chosen["x"], chosen["y"]
gz = table_z + chosen["height"]
approach = chosen.get("approach", [0, 1, 0])
finger_axis = chosen.get("finger_axis", [0, 0, 1])

# Pre-grasp position: 5 cm back along approach
pre_x = gx - 0.05 * approach[0]
pre_y = gy - 0.05 * approach[1]
pre_z = gz - 0.05 * approach[2]

open_gripper()
# Move to pre-grasp with horizontal approach
move_gripper(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="joint")

# Advance along approach into the edge
move_by(dx=0.05 * approach[0], dy=0.05 * approach[1], dz=0.05 * approach[2])
close_gripper()

# Lift straight up
retreat(dz=0.15)

# Carry to book pile, high enough to clear the pile
target_z = table_z + pile["top_height"] + 0.08
move_gripper(pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1], target_z, approach=approach, finger_axis=finger_axis, path="line")

# Lower notebook onto the pile
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.12)
go_home()
check("yellow_notebook", "book_pile")

table_z = obs["table_z"]
pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_notebook")

# Check candidates with solve_ik to find a reachable grasp
chosen = None
chosen_approach = None
chosen_finger_axis = None
chosen_pre = None

for c in candidates:
    if c.get("edge_free_below"):
        gx, gy = c["x"], c["y"]
        gz = table_z + c["height"]
        app = c.get("approach", [0, 1, 0])
        # Try both finger_axis directions: [0, 0, 1] and [0, 0, -1]
        for f_axis in [[0, 0, 1], [0, 0, -1]]:
            # Test slight variations or angles pointing away from base
            for dist in [0.04, 0.03]:
                pre = [gx - dist * app[0], gy - dist * app[1], gz - dist * app[2]]
                ik_pre = solve_ik(pre[0], pre[1], pre[2], approach=app, finger_axis=f_axis)
                ik_grip = solve_ik(gx, gy, gz, approach=app, finger_axis=f_axis)
                if ik_pre.get("reachable") and ik_grip.get("reachable"):
                    chosen = c
                    chosen_approach = app
                    chosen_finger_axis = f_axis
                    chosen_pre = (pre, dist)
                    break
            if chosen:
                break
    if chosen:
        break

if chosen and chosen_pre:
    pre, dist = chosen_pre
    open_gripper()
    move_gripper(pre[0], pre[1], pre[2], approach=chosen_approach, finger_axis=chosen_finger_axis, path="joint")
    move_by(dx=dist * chosen_approach[0], dy=dist * chosen_approach[1], dz=dist * chosen_approach[2])
    close_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    target_z = table_z + pile["top_height"] + 0.08
    move_gripper(pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1], target_z, approach=chosen_approach, finger_axis=chosen_finger_axis, path="line")
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.12)
else:
    # Fallback to standard grasp candidate if edge-pinch is completely unreachable
    cand = [c for c in candidates if c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]
    chosen = cand[0] if cand else candidates[0]
    grasp(chosen)
    carry_to(pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1], height=pile["top_height"] + 0.08)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.12)

go_home()
check("yellow_notebook", "book_pile")

obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
pile = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_notebook")

# Check edge-pinch candidate with modified approach pointing away from robot base
# Base is around (-0.56, 0.0), notebook at (-0.24, -0.37)
edge_cands = [c for c in candidates if c.get("edge_free_below")]
chosen = None
chosen_app = None
chosen_f_axis = None
dist = 0.04

for c in edge_cands:
    gx, gy = c["x"], c["y"]
    gz = table_z + c["height"]
    base_app = c.get("approach", [0, 1, 0])
    
    # Try nominal approach as well as rotated approaches (pointing away from robot)
    # base is at -0.56, so +x direction is away from robot
    test_approaches = [
        base_app,
        [0.7071 * base_app[0] + 0.7071, base_app[1], 0.0],
        [0.3, base_app[1], 0.0]
    ]
    for app in test_approaches:
        norm = math.sqrt(app[0]**2 + app[1]**2 + app[2]**2)
        unit_app = [app[0] / norm, app[1] / norm, app[2] / norm]
        for f_axis in [[0, 0, 1], [0, 0, -1]]:
            pre = [gx - dist * unit_app[0], gy - dist * unit_app[1], gz]
            ik1 = solve_ik(pre[0], pre[1], pre[2], approach=unit_app, finger_axis=f_axis)
            ik2 = solve_ik(gx, gy, gz, approach=unit_app, finger_axis=f_axis)
            if ik1.get("reachable") and ik2.get("reachable"):
                chosen = (gx, gy, gz)
                chosen_app = unit_app
                chosen_f_axis = f_axis
                break
        if chosen:
            break
    if chosen:
        break

if chosen:
    gx, gy, gz = chosen
    open_gripper()
    move_gripper(gx - dist * chosen_app[0], gy - dist * chosen_app[1], gz, approach=chosen_app, finger_axis=chosen_f_axis, path="joint")
    move_by(dx=dist * chosen_app[0], dy=dist * chosen_app[1], dz=0)
    close_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    target_z = table_z + pile["top_height"] + 0.08
    move_gripper(pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1], target_z, approach=chosen_app, finger_axis=chosen_f_axis, path="line")
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.12)
else:
    # If no edge pinch reachable, fallback to the best available candidate
    candidates.sort(key=lambda c: c.get("score", 0), reverse=True)
    grasp(candidates[0])
    carry_to(pile["center"][0], pile["center"][1], height=pile["top_height"] + 0.08)
    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.12)

go_home()
check("yellow_notebook", "book_pile")
